ACTIVE_EVENT_LIMIT_REACHED: You're running as many events as the free plan allows. One frees up when an event closes or you end one early.
EVENT_GALLERY_CLOSED: This event has closed. No one can join or add photos anymore.
EVENT_GALLERY_NOT_OPEN: This event hasn't opened yet. Photos can be added from its date.
EVENT_MEMBER_LIMIT_REACHED: This event is full. Ask an organizer to make room.
EVENT_SCHEDULE_LOCKED: The date and duration can only change before the event opens.
EVENT_STILL_ACTIVE: End the event, or wait for it to close, before deleting it.
EVENT_STORAGE_LIMIT_REACHED: There isn't enough room left in this event for these photos.
